flags.message: Statpack merits-docket table: Terms 2023 and 2024 look internally inconsistent — parsed + excluded exceeds granted (2023: 55 + 13 > 56; 2024: 73 + 34 > 75), while the pack-level totals reconcile (539 + 67 <= 607). Possibly the excluded rows are keyed to a different Term axis than the granted/parsed columns. Does not affect this cell's baseline (pooled disturbed/parsed over Terms 2017-2024 = 359/515 as the prompt instructs), but the per-Term excluded column may mislead a reader of the committed pack.
